title: An unclear image finds a living form

captions.physics: Giving an impression a trial form
captions.energy: Distinguishing imagination from what is known
captions.emotions: Enjoying a thought as it develops

meaning: Your shared view can become more fruitful when an unclear impression takes form and imagination stays connected with observation.
text: At first there may be only an image that is difficult to explain to each other. The Empress in the physical position of Ajna suggests giving it a trial form: drawing a sketch, assembling an example and looking at the result. The Moon in energy directs constructive interest towards uncertainty, distinguishing imagination from what is actually known. The Empress in emotions responds with pleasure in a thought’s development. The repeated card has different roles: you create material for understanding and enjoy the shared intention beginning to grow from it.

For example, you are choosing colours for a small card and struggle to explain “like early morning”. A few trial combinations reveal the difference between coolness and dullness. **A visible form helps explore an image that is not yet clear.** There is pleasure in an indistinct feeling acquiring understandable shades. You can discover what each person imagined behind the same words while preserving the initial image’s vitality. Observing particular versions lets it develop with room for each person’s perception.

The difficulty is treating an attractive meeting of colours as complete understanding of a shared feeling. You already like the image, so clarification can seem to interrupt its growth. Attention to uncertainty stays useful when it can notice this kind of difference too. A thought can have a successful expression and a meaning that remains open, giving it room to develop with both of you still involved.
